IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators McAuliffe, Eide, Regala, Franklin and Kohl-Welles

Bill.BriefDescription: Changing state board of education provisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to membership on the state board of education; andamending RCW 28A.305.010 and 28A.305.080.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.305.010 and 1992 c 56 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The state board of education shall be comprised of citizenmembers, and may include business leaders, community leaders, andparents, and shall reflect the racial and ethnic diversity of thestate's K12 student population and ensure that the geographic regionsof the state are represented. The board's voting membership shall beas follows: (a) One member from each congressional district of thestate, not including any congressional district at large, elected bythe members of the boards of directors of school districts thereof, ashereinafter in this chapter provided((,)); (b) the superintendent ofpublic instruction ((and)); (c) one member elected at large, asprovided in this chapter, by the members of the boards of directors ofall private schools in the state meeting the requirements of RCW28A.195.010; and (d) three members appointed by the governor andsubject to confirmation by the senate. The member representing private p. 1 SB 5547schools shall not vote on matters affecting public schools. If thereis a dispute about whether or not an issue directly affects publicschools, the dispute shall be settled by a majority vote of the othermembers of the board. (2) The governor's initial appointments shall be made by December31, 2003. (3) Appointed members shall serve for terms of four years, with theterms expiring on December 31st of the fourth year of the term.However, in the case of the initial members, two members shall servefouryear terms and one member shall serve a twoyear term, with eachof the terms expiring December 31st of the applicable year. Appointeesmay be reappointed to serve more than one term.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.305.080 and 1992 c 56 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The term of office of each elected member of the state board ofeducation shall begin on the second Monday in January next followingthe election at which he or she was elected, and he or she shall holdoffice for the term for which he or she was elected and until his orher successor is elected and qualified. Except as otherwise providedin RCW 28A.305.030, each elected member of the state board of educationshall ((be elected)) serve for a term of four years.
